messages:
eve: quick check before fridaykpiboard we're seeing traffic lift from launch posts but routed leads down ~15%. can we triage?

noah: Which tile? weekly -> routed_by_channel?

eve: yes, filter=launch-march, last_7_days. impressions up, routed leads down.

metrics-bot: nightly ETL finished at 06:08 UTC; looker.weekly_kpis refreshed. total_regs: 1,420

sam: quick query shows GA registrations 1,450, Looker 1,420, CRM routed 1,210. gap ~210. majority flagged as gclid-only or missing campaign_name.

dena: we shipped a small analytics script tweak yesterday that may have dropped utm_campaign when querystrings are long. that could create the missing campaign_name bucket.

noah: propose action: (1) one-off backfill mapping campaign_variant->campaign_name for last 10 days, (2) add "source concordance" KPI card with breakdown: utm_ok/gclid_only/scheme_change/dedupe, (3) inform ads-team about CPA delta.

ads-team: thanks for the heads-up. if ~200 reassign to paid, expect ~+10% CPA last week. we'll join the Friday review.

metrics-bot: KPI card added: "source concordance (draft)" by sam at 09:12

eve: thanks. sam can you post the cohort counts + SQL used? dena please schedule backfill and post job id. we'll keep the slide simple: numbers, root cause, and 3 remediation steps (landing script fix, move decoder earlier, schema-gating).

sam: cohort counts added -> utm_present:1,120; gclid_only:185; schema_shift:25; dedupe_delta:80. SQL snippet added to the KPI card.

dena: backfill scheduled bf-1712456789-1; ETA 28m. will post result here.

metrics-bot: backfill completed bf-1712456789-1; 179 rows updated, 4 failed (manual review). CRM routed now 1,389.

eve: great progress. we'll present the updated numbers + note on residual dedupe variance. thanks team. :thumbsup:
